name: Blazyn Bot
description: Blazyn WhatsApp multi-session bot for Blaze Tech.

TELEGRAM_TOKEN.description: Telegram bot token from @BotFather. Keep this value private.

TELEGRAM_OWNER_ID.description: Numeric Telegram user ID allowed to use owner-only Telegram commands.

REPORT_CHAT_ID.description: Optional numeric Telegram chat ID that receives issue reports.

OWNER_NAME.description: Public owner name shown by the bot.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Default WhatsApp owner number in international format.
